# MindVsYou

> MindVsYou is a browser-based CBSE Class 10 board exam practice platform. Students log in at quiz.mindvsyou.io with a Student ID and PIN — no app install required — and practice MCQs, case-based questions, and real Previous Year Questions (PYQs) for CBSE Class 10 Science (Mathematics coming soon), with instant answer explanations and progress tracking.

## Key facts
- Product: quiz.mindvsyou.io (the practice app). mindvsyou.io (this marketing site).
- Audience: CBSE Class 10 students; also schools and coaching institutes enrolling their students.
- Pricing: Free during beta for the first 100 students. No credit card required.
- Subjects available: Science (live). Mathematics (in development, not yet available).
- Practice formats: MCQs, case-based questions, VSA/SA/LA written-answer questions, full past-year board paper PDF downloads with official answer keys.
- Guests can try a few questions without registering; registration (Student ID + 4-digit PIN, no email/password) unlocks saved progress and a revision dashboard.
- Registered students get 50 new PYQ questions per day; guests are unlimited but won't repeat questions already seen in that browser.
- Contact: hello@mindvsyou.in
